edges.reason: transferOwnership is gated by onlyOwner comparing msg.sender with owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender to equal the staged newOwner.
msg.sender is compared against AdminAddress to bypass or enforce launch-window limits.
msg.sender is mixed into the randomness seed of randNumber.
msg.sender is the recipient of the refund transfer in receive().
block.timestamp selection between launch-window and normal trading rules.
block.timestamp is part of the randNumber seed, making the burn rate timestamp dependent.
Timestamp influence on the burn percentage makes the burn value miner-manipulable.
getPercentOfTrade executes the unchecked multiplication that overflows.
randNumber produces the predictable burn percentage unsafe operation.
receive() executes an external call to the caller address.
The external value transfer to msg.sender can invoke caller code that re-enters the trading logic.
firstTransfer latch decides whether the launch timer is started during transfer.
firstBlock is read to decide which trading limits apply.
AdminAddress exempts an account from the whale and bot restrictions.
_totalSupply is the denominator of the trade-percentage computation.
MinSupply is the floor checked before any burn is applied.
Sender and recipient balances are validated against the 1.99 token cap.
totalBurnt is incremented with the amount burned on each transfer.
transfer burns the randomly computed portion via _burn before moving tokens.
transfer moves the unburned remainder through _transfer.
transfer calls getPercentOfTrade to enforce the 3% post-window limit.
transfer calls randNumber to derive the burn percentage.
transferFrom delegates to _transferFrom.
_transferFrom moves balances through _transfer.
_transferFrom decrements the allowance via _approve.
burn entrypoint delegates the supply reduction to _burn.
approve sets the allowance through _approve.
increaseAllowance recomputes and stores the allowance via _approve.
decreaseAllowance recomputes and stores the allowance via _approve.
_burn writes the reduced _totalSupply.
_transfer writes the updated _balances entries.
The transfer amount parameter feeds the limit checks and the burn computation.
The recipient parameter is checked against the per-wallet token cap.
transferFrom sender parameter flows into the delegated transfer.
transferFrom recipient parameter flows into the delegated transfer.
transferFrom amount parameter flows into the delegated transfer.
numTokens input is scaled by 1000 inside getPercentOfTrade.
numTokens is multiplied into the numerator local.
The new owner parameter is stored into the pending owner slot.
The unchecked numerator local carries the overflowed product.
The temp local is derived from the overflowed numerator.
Sender parameter selects the balance debited in _transfer.
Recipient parameter selects the balance credited in _transfer.
Amount parameter is subtracted and added in _transfer.
The _rand local holds the computed pseudo-random percentage.
The _amountToBurn local is derived from the transaction amount and random rate.
The _unBurntToken local is the amount forwarded to the recipient.

normalization_plan.reason: The amount parameter exists only to drive the transfer limit checks and burn arithmetic.
The recipient parameter is used only for the wallet cap check inside transfer.
The sender parameter is a passthrough of transferFrom.
The recipient parameter is a passthrough of transferFrom.
The amount parameter is a passthrough of transferFrom.
The numTokens parameter only feeds the percentage computation.
The new owner parameter is only stored by transferOwnership.
The sender parameter only selects the debited balance in _transfer.
The recipient parameter only selects the credited balance in _transfer.
The amount parameter is only used to adjust balances in _transfer.
The _rand local is the return value of randNumber.
The _amountToBurn local is fully consumed by the transfer burn logic.
The _unBurntToken local is fully consumed by the transfer logic.
The numerator local is exactly the overflowed multiplication result.
The temp local is derived from the overflowed product and propagates the bad value.
